column1: # Stems that are not stable: stem(stem(w)) differs from stem(w). Reviewed by a native speaker (2026-11-16).
#   homograph   — the stem alone is read another way (jılıtıw → jılı, but jılı alone is jıl + ı)
#   misspelling — the stem comes from a misspelt form (bolalar for balalar)

column4: tolıp-tasıp: each part is stemmed alone
